ports.note: Two tables in, one out: the rows of the second under the first, columns lined up by name. Both must have the same value column and unit; a key column only one has is empty on the other's rows.

ontology.note: No ontology mapping yet. The receipt names how many rows came from each table and every column only one of them has.

changes.description: Stacks any number of tables, one port each, added from the Inspector; a label per table; the labels can be declared numbers in a unit, and a label that is not one is a data quality finding.

evidence.note: Unit tested on columns both, one and neither table hold, different value columns and units, and a source column that clashes. The Salmonella example uses it to stack 32 cases on 81 matched panel controls. Nothing here establishes that two tables are fit to be stacked.
